question: Do the Q24 deployment host's own internal approximation-quality observables, exported without perturbing the rollout, carry autonomous residual signal that the 20-channel native tape lacks - resolving the frame ambiguity left by the Q closure?
hypothesis: The development-frame Q null is ambiguous because its channels described the cp1792 host's approximation gaps while the target is the Q24 host's error. The aligned instances - the CP4 dropped planes the Q24 host materializes and discards 13 times per forward, the cubic and quartic residual stars, the t=24 Mehler last-term coupling, and the native correlation-graph structure - are literal components or direct diagnostics of the Q24 host's own approximation error, the very quantity the observer must predict.

authority.host_internals_map: independent source survey: _cp4_reset lines 931-994 (dropped planes at 969-973), _reset_stars 1127-1183, _repair_covariance 707-762, _q24_context 457-493 of the frozen instrumented estimator

stage1_generation.method: Load the frozen instrumented estimator (sha f539889324fb82cc1ded35a41c8b5a359014d9ddac52eab62949257e8e58a0ef), install pure-numpy capture wrappers on _repair_covariance, _cp4_reset, _reset_stars, and _q24_context that add ZERO metered operations, rerun predict_with_native_tape per row under the identical BudgetContext, and derive channels post-hoc outside the context.
stage1_generation.parity_law: Per row: recomputed host, raw20, and sigma payload hashes must equal the existing sealed native row's recorded array_sha256 values, and flops_used must be recorded alongside the reference row's for comparison. Any parity failure aborts the row and the run.
stage1_generation.call_count_and_mapping_law: Wrapper call counts must be exactly repair=14, cp4=15, stars=15, q24=15 per row; layer assignment is by call order (repair to layers 1..14, cp4/stars/q24 to layers 0..14), and every q24 call's sigma argument must equal the tape's sigma row for its assigned layer bit-exactly, pinning the mapping empirically per row.
stage1_generation.replication_cross_checks: The CP4 candidate construction, energy, stable argsort, and keep selection are replicated in float32-exact numpy from captured inputs and must reproduce the frozen _cp4_reset's returned retained lambdas bit-exactly at every call, capped or not, before any dropped-mass channel is derived.
stage1_generation.roster: The 200 existing native pilot rows, role ranks 35..234 inclusive.
stage1_generation.output: rows/row_NNNN/{r10_locals.npy float32 [16,1024,10], result.json}; existing native rows are never written.

channel_definitions.name: cp4_dropped_diagonal
channel_definitions.definition: At each capped _cp4_reset call assigned to layer l: the frozen float32 reader semantics ((u^2*u^2) @ lambda) applied to the dropped component set, divided by max(sigma^4, 1e-60). Zero when the call is uncapped (layers 0 and 1).

channel_definitions.name: cubic_star_row_rms
channel_definitions.definition: Row RMS of the returned cubic star (k21_target - cp_post_k21), divided by max(sigma^3, 1e-45).

channel_definitions.name: quartic_star_row_rms
channel_definitions.definition: Row RMS of the returned quartic star, divided by max(sigma^4, 1e-60).

channel_definitions.name: quartic_star_diagonal
channel_definitions.definition: Diagonal of the returned quartic star, divided by max(sigma^4, 1e-60).

channel_definitions.name: pairing_alpha
channel_definitions.definition: The returned per-layer pairing_alpha scalar broadcast to all units.

channel_definitions.name: mehler_t24_row_coupling
channel_definitions.definition: pair_left[0,0,24,:] * (rho^24 @ pair_right[0,0,24,:]) / 24!, the row-coupled last kept Mehler term for the first moment family.

channel_definitions.name: max_offdiagonal_abs_rho
channel_definitions.definition: Row maximum of |rho| with the exact identity subtracted, from the clipped native correlation.

channel_definitions.name: rho2_neighbor_alpha
channel_definitions.definition: ((rho*rho) @ alpha)/1024 with alpha = native tape channel 3.

channel_definitions.name: rho8_row_concentration
channel_definitions.definition: (sum_j rho_ij^8 - 1)/1024, a threshold-free coincident-bond concentration measure.

information_novelty_note: Channels 0-6 draw on objects the native tape never exports (dropped CP4 components, residual stars, pairing scalar, the 24th Mehler term's row coupling); channels 7-9 expose correlation-row structure beyond the tape's three row moments. The dead 0.99-threshold bond channel from the development frame was replaced by the threshold-free rho^8 concentration at design time, before any target metric.
psd_repair_note: The PSD repair loading is recorded per row as a receipt diagnostic, not a channel: the floor arm triggers only on near-dead-variance rows and is zero on the pilot roster's smoke row.

stage2_pilot_fit.law: Exactly the frozen J-native transfer pilot protocol with one change: 30 raw local channels (46 cell inputs). Same roster 35..234, same protected split law (blake2s-128 'p2r0f2j-q24-native-v1:'+mlp_id, first 40 protected), same 160-network fit, same exact J loss, six epochs, exposure schedule, optimizer, fixed final checkpoint, same shuffle stream id 40 for a paired batch order with the J-native pilot.
stage2_pilot_fit.architecture: Exact TransportEnergyMultiStateResidual semantics with INPUT_FEATURES 46; parameters 26560 (J's 25600 plus 10*96).
stage2_pilot_fit.standardization: Channel 0 unstandardized; channels 1..29 standardized by fit-split moments (19 native tails plus 10 r-channels), same floors and clamps as J.

decision_gate.achievability: Every conjunct was passed by the J-native pilot on the same split, so the gate is proven achievable.
decision_gate.fail: Close this exact r10 pilot spelling measured; no channel-subset sweep, no retune, no second seed.

scaling_rule.comparative_baseline: J-native pilot validation final MSE 3.107235383605394e-8 on the identical protected 40 networks
scaling_rule.full688_continuation_licensed_iff: pilot passes the decision gate AND validation final MSE < 3.045090675933286e-8 (at least 2% below the J-native pilot), a margin chosen before any R metric to exceed pilot-scale training noise
scaling_rule.otherwise: Close the leaf with the measured comparison; any different follow-up requires a new node.

firewalls.capacity_only: A pilot pass licenses only the separately preregistered full-688 native stage; nothing here changes the banked submission chain.

launch_gate.order: preregistration -> run manifest -> programs -> rank-36 sealed-form smoke -> independent adversarial audit -> seal -> 200-row generation with per-row parity -> generation receipt -> stage-2 pilot fit (first target read) -> result -> decomposition -> graph update
launch_gate.condition: No stage-2 target read before all 200 rows pass parity and the audit receipt exists.
